skill.name: hyperframes
skill.description: Create HyperFrames HTML video compositions with timed scenes, GSAP animation, captions, voiceovers, audio-reactive visuals, and scene transitions.
skill.summary: Author polished HyperFrames video compositions with motion, media timing, captions, narration, and transitions.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: The audit found no evidence of prompt injection, malware intent, credential exfiltration, or covert command execution. Most static hits are false positives from Markdown code formatting, JavaScript template literals, visual design terms, or dictionary key access; the confirmed issues are documented external API/CDN use and filesystem side effects that users should approve explicitly.

remediation.issue: External transcription examples upload user audio to OpenAI or Groq and use API keys from environment variables.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running those commands, and document which audio file and provider will receive data.

remediation.issue: Sample compositions load GSAP from a public CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a pinned local dependency or integrity-checked asset when generating production compositions.

remediation.issue: The TTS workflow stores downloaded models and voices under a hidden cache directory in the user home folder.
remediation.suggestion: Document the cache path, approximate size, and cleanup command before first use.

remediation.issue: The typography guide instructs users to write helper files under /tmp and fetch Google Fonts metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Offer an in-project temporary path or explain that the command creates disposable local files and performs a network request.

content.value_statement: HTML video projects need precise timing, motion, captions, and media structure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to build HyperFrames compositions with reusable production rules.
actual_capabilities: Defines HyperFrames composition structure with data attributes for timing, duration, tracks, media, and nested compositions.
Guides GSAP timeline authoring with deterministic animation rules and HyperFrames timeline registration.
Provides caption, transcript cleanup, karaoke, and word-timed text guidance for audio-driven videos.
Documents text-to-speech narration workflows using HyperFrames CLI voice and language options.
Routes scene transitions to CSS and shader transition references with rules for multi-scene compositions.
Includes local audit scripts for contrast reports and animation map inspection.
limitations: Requires the HyperFrames runtime and CLI for linting, preview, rendering, transcription, and text-to-speech workflows.
External transcription examples can upload audio to third-party APIs when the user chooses those commands.
Generated compositions still need visual review for timing, overflow, contrast, and transition quality.
Shader transition details depend on the separate @hyperframes/shader-transitions package source.

use_cases.title: Product Launch Video
use_cases.description: Build a multi-scene launch composition with brand colors, timed title cards, animated product points, and consistent transitions.

use_cases.title: Captioned Explainer
use_cases.description: Create a narrated tutorial with word-timed captions, readable typography, synchronized audio, and validation checks.

use_cases.title: Audio-Reactive Promo
use_cases.description: Map music or voice energy to pulses, glows, scale changes, and beat-synced visual emphasis in HyperFrames HTML.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Title Card
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 10 second HyperFrames title card for [topic]. Use [style or brand colors], one headline, one subtitle, and a clean entrance animation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Scene Explainer
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration] HyperFrames explainer with [number] scenes. Include scene timing, transitions, entrance animations, and separate audio if needed.

prompt_templates.title: Add Captions to Audio
prompt_templates.prompt: Add word-timed captions to this HyperFrames composition using [transcript file or audio file]. Keep captions readable and synchronized with the narration.

prompt_templates.title: Polish Motion and Validate
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this HyperFrames project for animation pacing, scene transitions, text overflow, contrast, and timeline registration. Fix issues and explain the changes.

output_examples.input: Create a 15 second product teaser with three scenes and bold kinetic typography.
output_examples.output: A HyperFrames composition plan with scene durations, typography direction, animated entrances, transition choices, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Turn this narration into captions for a tutorial video.
output_examples.output: A caption workflow with transcript cleanup, word grouping, readable styling, and synchronization guidance for the audio track.

output_examples.input: Make the visuals react to a music beat.
output_examples.output: Audio-reactive motion guidance that maps amplitude or frequency bands to glow, scale, opacity, and timed GSAP effects.

best_practices: Define visual identity before writing composition HTML, including colors, typography, and motion constraints.
Build each scene at its final readable layout before adding GSAP entrance animations.
Run HyperFrames lint, validate, inspect, and animation-map checks on new or complex compositions.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on jump cuts between scenes when a transition should carry the visual handoff.
Do not animate timeline construction asynchronously with setTimeout, promises, or media play calls.
Do not use generic web layouts with small centered text, dashboards, or unreviewed overflow.

faq.question: What is HyperFrames?
faq.answer: HyperFrames uses HTML, CSS, media elements, data attributes, and GSAP timelines to create renderable video compositions.

faq.question: Can this skill render the final video?
faq.answer: It guides composition authoring. Rendering, preview, transcription, and text-to-speech require the HyperFrames CLI and project setup.

faq.question: Does it support captions?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for transcript cleanup, word-level timing, karaoke effects, caption exits, and text overflow prevention.

faq.question: Can it create narration?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents local Kokoro-based text-to-speech workflows and how to add generated narration as an audio track.

faq.question: Does it use external services?
faq.answer: Most authoring is local. Optional transcription examples use OpenAI or Groq APIs and require user-provided API keys.

faq.question: What should users verify before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should verify timing, contrast, text overflow, transition behavior, audio sync, and any third-party API or CDN usage.
